## AKCA v0.3.2

This release fixes active vulnerability coverage after WAF/rate-limit responses and ships the crawler resilience improvements made after v0.3.1.

### Fixed

- XSS, SQLi, NoSQLi, and other priority vulnerability modules now wait for the host cooldown and resume their payload requests. Two earlier WAF/rate-limit responses no longer leave every eligible URL as `PARTIAL` without sending a probe.
- Crawler request guards now cover the HTTP client's complete transaction window, so valid slow responses, redirects, and retries are not cut off at 15 seconds.
- Incomplete crawl diagnostics group DNS, TLS, proxy, timeout, refused/reset connection, host-deferral, and request-budget failures instead of reporting only an undifferentiated network-error count.
- Sitemap discoveries survive an unavailable entry page, and one bounded browser recovery attempt remains available for entry-page transport failures.

### Installation

The Go module and downloadable binaries are built from the same release commit:

```bash
go install github.com/akha-security/akca/engine/cmd/akca@v0.3.2
```

The release workflow publishes Windows x64, Linux x64/ARM64, and macOS Intel/Apple Silicon executables plus `SHA256SUMS.txt` and build provenance attestations.

### Verification and limits

The full Go test suite, `go vet`, formatting, and the strict observed benchmark gate are run before publication. These checks do not establish zero false positives or complete validation of every module against live targets. Use AKCA only on systems you own or are authorized to test.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/akha-security/akca/compare/v0.3.1...v0.3.2
